description: This file defines the interface for Cellular Manager message bus operations, including initialization, finalization, bus check, and resource freeing functions. It includes license headers, macro definitions, and function prototypes related to message bus interactions in a cellular management component.

methods.name: CellularMgr_MessageBus_Init
methods.description: Initializes the message bus with component ID, configuration file, and path

methods.name: CellularMgr_Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Performs initialization of the message bus interface using user data

methods.name: CellularMgr_Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Performs cleanup and finalization of the message bus interface using user data

methods.name: CellularMgr_Mbi_BusCheck
methods.description: Checks the status of the message bus

methods.name: CellularMgr_Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources with specified priority and user data
